summary: Completed iteration 10 backend and frontend regression. Public APIs, hero film layer, coverage globe and all four sector updates, desktop/mobile overflow, navigation, capability tabs, relationship panel, contact submission, image loading, and seven-stage case-study scrolling all pass.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed contact inquiries and status records through the public regression suite; no seeded production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 were verified. Case-study stage 07 is reachable on both viewports and the compacted modal has no excessive bottom blank space. The only request failures were Emergent preview overlay report calls (ERR_ABORTED), not application media/assets; no console errors or broken rendered images were observed.
rca of the issue: Iteration 9's compacted case-study layout was revalidated successfully: the panel still provides enough scroll range for ratio-based mapping to activate all seven lifecycle stages while the mobile stage-07 view remains compact.
